agent_explanation: Single body fired upward hits the ceiling boundary. Incoming speed ~32.97 at step 231 becomes outgoing ~40.34 at step 232, i.e. the boundary impulse amplifies velocity instead of scaling by e=0.9 (expected ~29.7). With no gravity loss over one substep and no controller work, this injects ~270 J, pushing total energy 924.2 over allowed 724.6 and violating energy_bound. Setting e=0 removes the amplification and the run passes.
